parent_objective: audit M2365 target and guardrail slices before repair design or interpretation
blocked_by: M2365 materializes slices but does not choose repair route
offtrack target and collision guardrail slices require audit before repair
supersedes: direct repair from unreviewed localization output
profile or pack ranking from slice rows

public_gates: M2366 must audit M2365 summary, slice counts, route classes, and claim boundary without rerun
M2366 must identify the next bounded route or stop the branch
M2366 must keep ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the localized target and guardrail slice panel from the complete M2362 measured artifact
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2365 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if offtrack targets, collision guardrails, and R4 semantics cannot be separated
stop if audit would route directly to training without repair-design constraints
stop if audit attempts profile or pack ranking
fallback_plan: route to localization schema repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded offtrack/guardrail repair design if artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if localization is insufficient to choose a repair route

allowed_updates: M2366 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2365 artifacts are accepted or rejected
target and guardrail slice priorities are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2366 audits outcome slices and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2366; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2362 measured-execution artifact and M2365 localization output.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Weak localized outcomes should be routed as repair target or guardrail design inputs, not interpreted as ranking evidence.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns the measured outcome localization panel into audited route selection evidence
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded repair design but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2366 cannot audit or route from localization artifacts
M2366 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the outcome-localization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2365 localization artifacts can decide the next bounded repair-design route without rerun, ranking, or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2365 slice counts and route classes are audited
target, guardrail, and R4 semantics priorities are summarized
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2366 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2366 ranks support policies or controller families
M2366 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2366 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2366 cannot decide next route from complete localization artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2365 outcome-localization artifacts

decision_rule: M2366 passes if it audits M2365 localization artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
